verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents serving your own fine-tuned weights on dedicated, autoscaling A100–B300 instances with private endpoints. It also offers B200/B300 GPU clusters "for training" with SSH access, so both steps can happen on the same platform. However, fine-tuning is only possible by renting raw clusters and running your own training stack, not through a managed fine-tuning API for supported base models. Missing for 10: a managed fine-tuning job API or workflow for catalog base models, documentation of handing trained weights from cluster to deployment, details on supported base models or LoRA adapters, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
